claims.statement: Girvan and Newman published Community Structure in Social and Biological Networks in PNAS 99(12) pp7821-7826 on June 11 2002
claims.locator: PNAS original p7821 masthead, PubMed publisher

claims.statement: GN distinguished detection of unknown uneven sized network communities from prespecified balanced graph partitioning
Wayne W Zachary published original karate club fission social network field study in J Anthropological Research 33(4) 452-473 in 1977
claims.locator: U Chicago publisher metadata and abstract

claims.statement: Girvan Newman edge betweenness generalizes Freeman point betweenness to count shortest-path shares through each edge
GN repeatedly deletes maximal edge betweenness and recalculates betweennesses after every deletion, not one-time rankings
Original 2002 GN implementation has single sweep O(mn) and worst-case full algorithm O(m²n) for n vertices m edges
GN paper analyzed unweighted Zachary 34-member karate club network, initial major split mismatched observed factions only at node 3
GN paper examined 2000-season US college American football game schedule and recovered much conference grouping
Two triangles ABC DEF joined only by CD: edge betweenness CD=9, AC=4, AB=1 when unordered vertex pairs each contribute unity
claims.locator: original six vertex derivation and networkx-checkable

claims.statement: After removal of CD the two triangles separate, remaining triangle edges have betweenness one within their components
Detected network partition need not reveal individual identity, sentiments or causal origin of actual group fission
claims.locator: retrospective historical evidence versus causal inference

claims.statement: 2004 Newman Girvan method introduced explicit quality score for network community partition selection
claims.locator: Phys Rev E p1 abstract and modularity section
